dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.api.template.persistence.migrate>
<!description: Migrate from deprecated org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.persistence types to org.eclipse.text.templates.>
<!severity: WARNING>
<!tags: deprecated, api-migration, eclipse>

<!map DeprecatedTemplateTypes: "org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.persistence.TemplatePersistenceData" => "org.eclipse.text.templates.TemplatePersistenceData", "org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.persistence.TemplateReaderWriter" => "org.eclipse.text.templates.TemplateReaderWriter">

#{DeprecatedTemplateTypes}
=> #{DeprecatedTemplateTypes_VALUE}
;;
summary: Replaces usages of deprecated TemplatePersistenceData and TemplateReaderWriter types from org.eclipse.jface.text.templates.persistence with their equivalents from org.eclipse.text.templates.
